Profile Jalap is the dried tubercles of Ipomoea purga (=Exogonium pur- ga) (Convolvulaceae). Jalap resin is a mixture of glycosidal res- ins obtained by extraction of jalap with alcohol and it has a dras- tic purgative and irritant action. It has been superseded by less toxic laxatives.
